N_full_exempt.long_name: Number of students with any vaccination exemption
N_full_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
N_full_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.
